# Devil Clauses
Write each clause on its own line as [bold]Contractee: Name[/bold] or [bold]Contractor: Name[/bold], using the names below. Capitals and spaces do not matter. A contract can be signed once its total weight is [bold]0 or more[/bold]. Negative weight helps whoever receives the clause, and positive weight hurts them. See [textlink="Devil" link="Devil"] for how deals work.
Nothing undoes a clause once the contract is signed, except where noted below.
## Helpful clauses
## Mortality
[color=#999999][italic]-135 Weight[/italic][/color]
- Grants Cheat Death with unlimited revives. It is usable only while dead, has a 250 second cooldown, and fails while the body carries 100 or more holy damage.
## Weakness
[color=#999999][italic]-35 Weight[/italic][/color]
- Halves brute, heat, cold, poison, radiation and bleeding damage, but holy damage is increased by half. - Replaces the target's damage resistances, including those from their species.
## Death
[color=#999999][italic]-25 Weight[/italic][/color]
- Grants Cheat Death with a single revive, usable only while dead. - Included on every new contract.
## Fear of Death
[color=#999999][italic]-25 Weight[/italic][/color]
- Removes the critical state: you stay standing until 200 damage, then die.
## Shadows
[color=#999999][italic]-25 Weight[/italic][/color]
- Makes the contractee invisible while standing still. Moving reveals them.
## Brokeness
[color=#999999][italic]-20 Weight[/italic][/color]
- Grants a pair of sick fucking jays, signed by Michael Jordan himself. - They make you 20% faster and can be toggled to stop you slipping. Once they have taken enough damage they crease, and creased jays slow you down.
## Fear of Fire
[color=#999999][italic]-20 Weight[/italic][/color]
- Heat and radiation no longer do any damage, and high temperatures are harmless. Shock and bleeding damage are also reduced. - Replaces the target's damage resistances, including those from their species.
## Chance
[color=#999999][italic]-20 Weight[/italic][/color]
- Grants a completely random clause, helpful or harmful. Want to try your luck?
## Fear of Light
[color=#999999][italic]-15 Weight[/italic][/color]
- Makes the contractee immune to flashes.
## Fear of Electricity
[color=#999999][italic]-15 Weight[/italic][/color]
- Makes the contractee immune to electrical shocks.
## Gluttony
[color=#999999][italic]-10 Weight[/italic][/color]
- Removes the need for food and water.
## Fear of Drowning
[color=#999999][italic]-10 Weight[/italic][/color]
- Removes the need to breathe.
## Fear of Clowns
[color=#999999][italic]-10 Weight[/italic][/color]
- Prevents slipping.
## Fear of Crushing
[color=#999999][italic]-10 Weight[/italic][/color]
- Makes the contractee immune to pressure damage.
## Fear of Freezing
[color=#999999][italic]-10 Weight[/italic][/color]
- Makes the contractee immune to low temperatures.
## Greed
[color=#999999][italic]-10 Weight[/italic][/color]
- Grants 30,000 spesos in cash.
## Pain
[color=#999999][italic]-5 Weight[/italic][/color]
- The contractee feels no pain, and their injuries no longer slow them down. - Any full heal, including Cheat Death, takes away the numbness again.
## Harmful clauses
## Voice
[color=#999999][italic]20 Weight[/italic][/color]
- Mutes the contractee. - Any full heal, including Cheat Death, gives the voice back.
## Soul Ownership
[color=#999999][italic]25 Weight[/italic][/color]
- Gives the contractee's soul to the devil who summoned the contract, and condemns them. - Included on every new contract.
## Strength
[color=#999999][italic]30 Weight[/italic][/color]
- Doubles brute, cold, poison, radiation, bleeding and holy damage taken. Heat and shock are unchanged. - Replaces the target's damage resistances, including those from their species.
## Coherence
[color=#999999][italic]30 Weight[/italic][/color]
- Makes the contractee clumsy and makes them speak backwards.
## Awake
[color=#999999][italic]35 Weight[/italic][/color]
- Narcolepsy: every 5 to 10 minutes, the contractee falls asleep for 10 to 30 seconds.
## Legs
[color=#999999][italic]40 Weight[/italic][/color]
- Permanently paralyzes both legs.
## Sight
[color=#999999][italic]60 Weight[/italic][/color]
- Permanently blinds the contractee.
## Will to Fight
[color=#999999][italic]60 Weight[/italic][/color]
- Permanently pacifies the contractee.
## Humanity
[color=#999999][italic]80 Weight[/italic][/color]
- Turns the contractee into a frog, inventory and all. - The frog turns back into the contractee if it is critically hurt or killed.
## Time
[color=#999999][italic]150 Weight[/italic][/color]
- Kills the contractee after five minutes. - The body can never be revived afterwards, by Cheat Death or anything else.
